hadolint, as shipped in the ASH container image
===============================================

The file /usr/local/bin/hadolint in this image is hadolint v2.15.1, an
unmodified release binary downloaded from

    https://github.com/hadolint/hadolint/releases/tag/v2.15.1

and verified against the SHA256 digests published with that release (they are
pinned in automated_security_helper/utils/tool_downloads.py in the ASH source).

hadolint is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3. The full
text is in LICENSE in this directory, copied verbatim from the hadolint
repository at that tag. hadolint statically includes other software. Its own
license report for this release, ThirdPartyNotices.txt in this directory (also
copied verbatim from that tag), lists every Haskell dependency with its version
and license, among them ShellCheck (GPL-3.0-only), language-docker
(GPL-3.0-or-later) and HsYAML (GPL-2.0-only). The Linux build is linked
statically against musl libc (MIT) and the GNU Multiple Precision Arithmetic
Library (GMP, LGPL-3.0-or-later or GPL-2.0-or-later).

Corresponding source
--------------------
The complete corresponding source code for this binary is the hadolint source
tree at tag v2.15.1 (commit 2eece55955ced00200be9729e9728cb7dacca505):

    https://github.com/hadolint/hadolint/tree/v2.15.1
    https://github.com/hadolint/hadolint/archive/refs/tags/v2.15.1.tar.gz

together with the source of the dependency versions listed in
ThirdPartyNotices.txt. ASH does not modify
hadolint. ASH runs it only as a separate process, passing file names on its
command line and reading the report it writes; ASH does not link to it.
